Subject: Pilot close — can we get a short runway/top-up?

Hey Tessa,

Quick one — the NovaCorp team is running into the last set of evaluation tests and we need a small top-up to finish the performance runs before our internal review on Oct 1. Can you do a 7-day extension on the trial and a ~250k token credit so we can hit the end-to-end checks? Without it they won’t change momentum to procurement.

We’re really close on latency and cost per inference; if we can show the full pipeline they’ve committed to a POC purchase next quarter. Can you let me know by EOD Monday (Sep 27) so I can keep the execs from escalating?

—Samir
Samir Patel

Samir — thanks for the note and congrats on getting this far.

Short answer: yes, we can typically do a short extension + one-off credit for pilots like this, but I need a quick internal approval. Proposed offer I can ask for now: 7-day trial extension + 250k token pilot allowance (non-recurring). I’ll put together a one-page amendment and loop in finance/ops — can you confirm the exact evaluation date and whether procurement will need an amendment on the SOW?

If procurement needs a DocuSign amendment I’ll include it with the credit terms (one-off, expires 15 days after issuance). I’ll aim to get an answer by Tue EOD.

—Tessa Morgan

Subject: Request: one-off pilot credit for NovaCorp (DEAL-9371) — urgent EOD 9/29

Ben / Marissa —

Summary: NovaCorp (DEAL-9371) is asking for a 7-day extension + pilot allowance to complete E2E evaluation. Customer notes this is the gating item for procurement and an ARR conversion next quarter.

Why approve:
- Strategic vertical: enterprise fintech (high expansion potential).
- Likelihood to convert: high — customer execs explicitly linked purchase to successful E2E tests.
- Expected ARR: ~$225k ARR annualized if POC converts.

Requested terms:
- 250,000 token one-time credit (approx. $4k list equivalent)
- 7-day extension to trial window starting on approval
- Credit non-recurring; expires Oct 15 if unused

Attachments: credit rationale memo (short) and proposed amendment stub.

If you can’t approve full amount, a partial allowance is fine — even 150–200k will keep the evaluation honest. Need an explicit decision by EOD 2027-09-29 so Samir can schedule the final test.

Thanks — I’ll handle the DocuSign amendment once we have the greenlight.

—Tessa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-09-29T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off pilot credit for NovaCorp (DEAL-9371) — urgent EOD 9/29

Tessa —

Approve but with a cap and reduced extension:
- Approve a 200,000 token one-time credit (non-recurring).
- Approve a 5-day extension to the trial window (starting on issuance).
- Condition: credit expires Oct 15; include clause that any production purchase will be billed at standard rates and credits are non-transferable.

Reasoning: close enough to your ask to preserve momentum and keeps downside small. Please get a signed amendment (DocuSign) and record the approval in the credit approvals portal. I attached a short note with the approval timestamp.

—Ben
